vanta-motors.heading: Discover the drive that moves you.
vanta-motors.body: A great machine deserves more than a specification sheet. Explore the paths from first impression to personal discovery.
vanta-motors.prompt: How would you like to explore?
vanta-motors.helper: Choose a discovery route to preview the next step.

halcyon-estates.heading: Space to imagine what comes next.
halcyon-estates.body: From city residences to architectural retreats, browse a curated set of possibilities before arranging a real viewing.
halcyon-estates.helper: Switch between residential, commercial and conceptual spaces.

veil-wellness.heading: A quieter path to feeling your best.
veil-wellness.body: Discover a consultation journey built around informed questions, considered options and individual comfort.
veil-wellness.prompt: Where would you like to begin?
veil-wellness.helper: Preview a personalized discovery flow. No treatment or booking is offered.

nexus-cloud.heading: See what a connected workflow feels like.
nexus-cloud.body: Make the complicated feel intuitive. Explore a product path designed for clarity, collaboration and forward motion.
nexus-cloud.helper: Try the local interface with no account or data connection.

arcus-architecture.heading: From first sketch to lasting form.
arcus-architecture.body: Every meaningful space begins with a question. Explore the stages of a thoughtful architectural process.
arcus-architecture.helper: Move through concept, specification and care.

aster-escapes.heading: Where will the journey take you?
aster-escapes.body: Imagine the rhythm of your stay. Discover an elegant trip-planning experience without making an actual reservation.
aster-escapes.helper: Select a demonstration date and party size to explore the flow.

forge-roofing.heading: A roof deserves the right questions.
forge-roofing.body: Explore how a clear inspection and project process helps you plan the next step without pressure or guesswork.
forge-roofing.prompt: What would you like to evaluate?
forge-roofing.helper: Browse inspection, material and planning stages. No quote is provided.

phase-electric.heading: Clarity at every connection.
phase-electric.body: From initial questions to system planning, take a guided look at a thoughtful electrical-service experience.
phase-electric.helper: Explore service categories in a local demonstration.

lumen-solar.heading: Explore a brighter energy plan.
lumen-solar.body: Use a simple interactive space study as the first step toward understanding options. This is not a savings forecast.
lumen-solar.helper: Move the slider to compare illustrative sizes, not actual power production.

vault-private.heading: Insight, with room to think.
vault-private.body: An elegant client experience should give people clarity and control, without unsupported promises or invented performance.
vault-private.helper: Navigate a fictional discovery process. No investment advice is provided.

remedy-restore.heading: Know what happens next.
remedy-restore.body: A calm, accessible response journey helps people understand documentation, assessment and the restoration process.
remedy-restore.helper: Review the sequence without placing a real emergency request.

sync-creative.heading: Ideas become tangible here.
sync-creative.body: Explore different creative directions in a studio experience where strategy, craft and expression can meet.
sync-creative.helper: Switch between study categories and see the local interface respond.

heritage-homes.heading: Make more of the space you love.
heritage-homes.body: See how a considered renovation process moves from ideas and planning to the detail that makes a home personal.
heritage-homes.helper: Explore a locally simulated home-project journey.

flow-home.heading: Every detail, flowing together.
flow-home.body: Help homeowners find the right starting point for maintenance, repair or an upgrade through a reassuring digital path.
flow-home.helper: Choose a local demonstration option. No service call is dispatched.

nova-performance.heading: Make your next step count.
nova-performance.body: Find a balanced starting point for movement, training and recovery in a focused, accessible member experience.
nova-performance.helper: Discover training and recovery categories in a fictional studio.

eclipse-time.heading: The details are the difference.
eclipse-time.body: Explore finish, character and craftsmanship in a product experience designed for considered decisions.
eclipse-time.helper: Preview product finishes locally. Purchasing is not enabled.

aurora-dental.heading: Care begins with understanding.
aurora-dental.body: An inviting patient journey should make room for questions, clear expectations and confident next steps.
aurora-dental.helper: Try the appointment-flow demonstration. No patient details are collected.
